FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtext: Everything you need to know about ALLOMA AI and how it can transform your legal studies.
FAQ.a1: ALLOMA AI is an educational platform designed specifically for law students, integrating First Principles thinking, Socratic AI tutoring, and Spaced Repetition to help you truly understand rather than just memorize the law.
FAQ.q2: Is it suitable for practicing lawyers?
FAQ.a2: Yes, while primarily designed for students, practicing lawyers can use the Dynamic Mind Map and Socratic dialogue to structure complex casework and arguments effectively.
FAQ.q3: How does the AI Tutor work?
FAQ.a3: The Socratic AI Tutor doesn't just give you answers. It asks guiding questions to help you reach conclusions on your own, ensuring deep comprehension of legal reasoning.
FAQ.a4: Absolutely. Your essays, cases, and study materials are kept strictly confidential and are not used to train generic AI models.
FAQ.q5: Can I use it on mobile?
FAQ.a5: Yes, ALLOMA AI is fully responsive and can be accessed on smartphones, tablets, and desktops for studying on the go.
